description: Hook points fired by the agent-fsm cells (idle, think, wait, act); the loop points after_start / after_stop are in py/aos/apps/hook/loop_points.json.

before_queue.when: idle: a good letter is about to enter the conversation (/compact letters do not pass here)

fields.content: the text that will enter the conversation

before_queue.if_blocked: the letter is closed and dropped; mailbox_warning.txt says which hook dropped it

after_queue.when: idle: the letter is in history.jsonl and closed

before_tool.when: act: before each tool call runs (every tool)

fields.name: tool name
fields.arguments: the parsed JSON arguments the tool will get

before_tool.subject: tool
before_tool.if_blocked: the tool does not run; the brain gets the hook's stdout (or a default line) as the tool result

after_tool.when: act: a tool finished, before its result enters history (not for a blocked tool)

fields.name: tool name
fields.code: the tool's exit code, null when it timed out

after_tool.subject: tool

brain_failed.when: wait: asking the brain did not work

fields.name: error code: LlmKernelMissing, SendFailed, BudgetMissing, BrainFailed or ReplyBad
fields.error: the kernel's error object, when there is one (BudgetMissing, BrainFailed)
fields.code: BrainFailed only, when the kernel's error has it: the kernel's code
fields.status: BrainFailed only, when the kernel's error has it: the HTTP status
fields.retry: BrainFailed only: true when the same request is sent again after a wait, false when the agent stops
fields.attempt: BrainFailed only: failures in a row
fields.wait_s: BrainFailed only, when retry is true: seconds until the next try

brain_failed.subject: code

tool_added.when: think: a tool name appeared in the tool box since the last request (the first look only remembers the names)
tool_added.subject: tool

on_clock.when: start of every cell: the hook's clock moved on by its own every_cycles / every_ms (also once right after a start)

fields.first: true right after a start, a wake or a clock change
fields.last_cycle: cycle of the last run, or null
fields.config: the entry's config, when it has one
